auditLocation: Production table "IngestionAudit", action JOURNAL_SOURCE_IMPORT, meta.runId = this run id: one entry per batch, each listing inserted id, issn, dept, sourceId and evidence.

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM "Journal" j WHERE j.id = ANY($1::text[]) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Article" a WHERE a."journalId" = j.id) RETURNING j.id, j.issn
rollback.scope: the exact inserted ids of this run; the rightsBasis label is shared with other runs and is NOT a safe scope

fks.def: FOREIGN KEY ("journalId") REFERENCES "Journal"(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE SET NULL

rollback.note: Article.journalId is ON DELETE SET NULL, so the NOT EXISTS guard is essential. Re-count articles, ingestion runs and library events for these ids before any use. Audit rows have no foreign key and are never deleted.
